projects.title: Set up your ML workbench
projects.desc: Create a GitHub repo "ml-rl-journey" with folders per course. Set up a Python env with numpy, matplotlib, scikit-learn, PyTorch, gymnasium and jupyter. Add a NOTES.md you will update every Sunday.
projects.deliverable: Repo with environment file and a hello-world notebook that trains a tiny sklearn model.

projects.title: Linear algebra from scratch
projects.desc: Implement Gram-Schmidt, least squares via QR, and PCA via SVD in numpy. Compress a photo with truncated SVD at ranks 5, 20, 50 and plot the reconstruction error.
projects.deliverable: Notebook with plots and a short paragraph on what SVD rank means.

projects.title: Probability simulation lab
projects.desc: Simulate the birthday paradox, coupon collector, Monte-Carlo estimate of pi, and empirical vs Chernoff-bound tail probabilities for coin flips.
projects.deliverable: Notebook comparing every simulation with its closed-form answer.

projects.title: Gradient descent lab
projects.desc: Implement gradient descent, momentum and Newton's method; show on ill-conditioned quadratics how the condition number controls convergence.
projects.deliverable: Plots of iterates on contour maps and a convergence-rate table.

projects.title: Classical ML from scratch library
projects.desc: Package LinearRegression, LogisticRegression, DecisionTree and KMeans with fit/predict APIs and unit tests that compare against sklearn.
projects.deliverable: A pip-installable mini library with tests passing.

projects.title: End-to-end tabular project
projects.desc: On the UCI Bank Marketing dataset: EDA, a clean sklearn Pipeline, cross-validated logistic regression vs gradient boosting, threshold tuning for business cost.
projects.deliverable: Notebook plus a one-page write-up a manager could read.

projects.title: Your own autograd + MLP library
projects.desc: Extend the week-3 micrograd engine to vectors (or follow Karpathy's micrograd), add an MLP class and an SGD optimiser, and train it on make_moons.
projects.deliverable: Library code, a decision-boundary plot, and gradients checked against PyTorch.

projects.title: Vision and sequence models
projects.desc: Fine-tune a pretrained ResNet on a small image dataset; train a character-level GPT (nanoGPT-style) on a text corpus of your choice.
projects.deliverable: Two notebooks with training curves and samples.

projects.title: Bandit testbed
projects.desc: Reproduce Sutton & Barto Figures 2.2-2.4: epsilon-greedy, optimistic initial values and UCB on the 10-armed testbed. Add Thompson sampling.
projects.deliverable: Plots that match the book, plus your own Thompson curve.

projects.title: Grid-world dynamic programming
projects.desc: Implement iterative policy evaluation, policy iteration and value iteration on a 4x4 grid world; visualise V and the greedy policy after each sweep.
projects.deliverable: Notebook with heatmaps and iteration counts for each method.

projects.title: Tabular control
projects.desc: Monte-Carlo control on Blackjack (gymnasium) and SARSA vs Q-learning on CliffWalking. Reproduce Sutton & Barto Figure 6.4.
projects.deliverable: Learned Blackjack policy plot and the cliff-walking reward curves.

projects.title: Linear function approximation
projects.desc: Semi-gradient SARSA with tile coding on MountainCar-v0. Plot steps per episode and the learned cost-to-go function.
projects.deliverable: Agent that reaches the flag consistently, with plots.

projects.title: DQN from scratch
projects.desc: PyTorch DQN with replay buffer and target network on CartPole-v1 (aim for 500 reward). Ablate the replay buffer and the target network.
projects.deliverable: Learning curves for the full agent and each ablation.

projects.title: Policy gradients
projects.desc: REINFORCE with a baseline, then advantage actor-critic (A2C) on CartPole and LunarLander.
projects.deliverable: Learning curves comparing REINFORCE, REINFORCE+baseline and A2C.

projects.title: Options in Four Rooms
projects.desc: Implement the Four Rooms domain with hallway options; compare learning speed of primitive-action Q-learning vs SMDP Q-learning with options.
projects.deliverable: Plot of steps-to-goal vs episodes for both.

projects.title: Contextual bandit for bank offers
projects.desc: Simulate customers with features and 5 product offers. Compare LinUCB, linear Thompson sampling and epsilon-greedy online, then evaluate offline with the replay method.
projects.deliverable: Notebook and a short note on how this would plug into a real recommendation pipeline.

projects.title: Stochastic approximation experiments
projects.desc: Compare step-size schedules (1/n, 1/n^0.6, constant) for Robbins-Monro mean estimation; run TD(0) with linear features; reproduce Baird's counterexample diverging.
projects.deliverable: Plots for each experiment with one-line conclusions.

projects.title: LQR vs reinforcement learning
projects.desc: Control a linearised cart-pole with LQR, then with your DQN or policy-gradient agent. Compare performance and how much data/model knowledge each needed.
projects.deliverable: Side-by-side rollouts and a comparison table.

projects.title: Consensus simulation
projects.desc: Simulate consensus on ring, star and random graphs; relate convergence speed to the Laplacian's second eigenvalue.
projects.deliverable: Plots of agent states over time and lambda_2 vs convergence time.

projects.title: Learning in games
projects.desc: Regret matching and CFR on Kuhn poker; independent Q-learners in a matrix game. Check convergence to equilibrium.
projects.deliverable: Exploitability-over-time plot for CFR.

phase7.title: OpenAI Spinning Up: Parts 1-3
phase7.desc: Key concepts, kinds of RL algorithms, intro to policy optimisation.

phase7.title: Berkeley CS285: actor-critic and advanced policy gradients lectures
phase7.desc: Watch the actor-critic, policy-gradient and advanced policy-gradient (TRPO/PPO) lectures.

phase7.title: PPO from scratch
phase7.desc: Implement PPO (use CleanRL's ppo.py as a reference, not a copy) on LunarLander and one continuous-control task. Log with TensorBoard.

phase7.title: SAC and offline RL
phase7.desc: Read the SAC paper overview in Spinning Up, run Stable-Baselines3 SAC on Pendulum, and read a survey intro on offline RL (e.g. CQL).

phase7.title: Model-based RL
phase7.desc: Read CS285's model-based RL lectures; skim the MuZero and DreamerV3 papers.

phase7.title: RLHF and DPO
phase7.desc: Hugging Face Deep RL course RLHF unit, then fine-tune a small language model with DPO using the TRL library.

phase7.title: Capstone
phase7.desc: Pick one: (a) build a custom gymnasium environment from your work domain (e.g. network capacity allocation) and solve it with PPO; or (b) reproduce one figure from a published deep-RL paper. Write a blog post and publish the repo.
